description: 通道消息生命周期完整链路

chain.name: submit
chain.description: 侧车/通道将消息提交到后端

chain.name: queue
chain.description: 投递队列持久化与调度
chain.flow: SQLite delivery_intents 表 → Worker轮询(batch=10, interval=1s)

chain.name: worker
chain.flow: Worker.processBatch → 按channel路由到对应Adapter → 删除已投递记录

chain.name: sidecar
chain.description: 通道适配器调用侧车HTTP接口
chain.flow: QQChannelAdapter.Deliver → POST sidecar/api/send | WechatChannelAdapter.Deliver → POST sidecar/api/send

chain.name: deliver
chain.description: 侧车将消息送达最终用户
chain.flow: 侧车HTTP服务接收 → 调用微信/QQ协议发送给用户
